name: Pallas Projects/Studios
funding: The Arts Council is the key funder. Dublin City Council and the Department of Culture, Communications and Sport contribute to capital funding.

name: Project Arts Centre
funding: The Arts Council / An Chomhairle Ealaíon, Dublin City Council, non-commercial ticket sales. Registered Charity No. 20008447.

name: Temple Bar Gallery + Studios
funding: Arts Council is principal funder. Dublin City Council, Culture Ireland and others give grants. Corporate partners: Henry J Lyons, Arthur Cox and Dublin Port. RTÉ Supporting the Arts.

name: Ormston House
funding: The Arts Council's An Invitation to Collaboration scheme co-funded its River Residencies.

name: Lismore Castle Arts
funding: Not-for-profit initiative founded 2005. Exhibitions are funded by the Arts Council and the Waterford City & County Council Arts Grant; an older page also lists the Henry Moore Foundation.

name: Haifa Museum of Art
funding: Municipal museum group Haifa Museums. Site logos: Haifa Municipality, Ministry of Culture and Sport, Mizrahi Tefahot bank. Japan's embassy gave NIS 15,620 for a 2025 Tikotin show.

name: Arab-Hebrew Theatre of Jaffa (Al-Saraya)
funding: Partly funded by Israel's Ministry of Culture and the Tel Aviv Municipality. In 2017 co-director Igal Ezrati put public funds at nearly NIS 900,000, a significant share of its budget.

name: Israel Museum
funding: American Friends of the Israel Museum raised over $450M since 1972. Mandel and Safra foundations each gave $12M in 2009. 2025: state and city grants 21% of income, donations 27%.

name: Petach Tikva Museum of Art
funding: Friends association (2015) funds shows and acquisitions via 1,800 NIS memberships and a 23,000 NIS patron tier. British Friends of the Art Museums of Israel back programmes. No budget published.
